verses.en: There was a certain man in Caesarea called Cornelius, a centurion of the band called the Italian band,
verses.pt: Um homem em Cesaréia, por nome Cornélio, centurião da coorte chamada italiana,
verses.en_web: Now there was a certain man in Caesarea, Cornelius by name, a centurion of what was called the Italian Regiment,
verses.en_bbe: Now there was a certain man in Caesarea, named Cornelius, the captain of the Italian band of the army;

verses.en: A devout man, and one that feared God with all his house, which gave much alms to the people, and prayed to God alway.
verses.pt: piedoso e temente a Deus com toda a sua casa, e que fazia muitas esmolas ao povo e de contínuo orava a Deus,
verses.en_web: a devout man, and one who feared God with all his house, who gave gifts for the needy generously to the people, and always prayed to God.
verses.en_bbe: A serious-minded man, fearing God with all his family; he gave much money to the poor, and made prayer to God at all times.

verses.en: He saw in a vision evidently about the ninth hour of the day an angel of God coming in to him, and saying unto him, Cornelius.
verses.pt: cerca da hora nona do dia, viu claramente em visão um anjo de Deus, que se dirigia para ele e lhe dizia: Cornélio!
verses.en_web: At about the ninth hour of the day, he clearly saw in a vision an angel of God coming to him, and saying to him, “Cornelius!”
verses.en_bbe: He saw in a vision, clearly, at about the ninth hour of the day, an angel of the Lord coming to him and saying to him, Cornelius!

verses.en: And when he looked on him, he was afraid, and said, What is it, Lord? And he said unto him, Thy prayers and thine alms are come up for a memorial before God.
verses.pt: Este, fitando nele os olhos e atemorizado, perguntou: Que é, Senhor? O anjo respondeu-lhe: As tuas orações e as tuas esmolas têm subido para memória diante de Deus;
verses.en_web: He, fastening his eyes on him, and being frightened, said, “What is it, Lord?” He said to him, “Your prayers and your gifts to the needy have gone up for a memorial before God.
verses.en_bbe: And he, looking on him in fear, said, What is it, Lord? And he said to him, Your prayers and your offerings have come up to God, and he has kept them in mind.

verses.en: And now send men to Joppa, and call for one Simon, whose surname is Peter:
verses.pt: agora, pois, envia homens a Jope e manda chamar a Simão, que tem por sobrenome Pedro;
verses.en_web: Now send men to Joppa, and get Simon, who is also called Peter.
verses.en_bbe: Now send men to Joppa, and get one Simon, named Peter,

verses.en: He lodgeth with one Simon a tanner, whose house is by the sea side: he shall tell thee what thou oughtest to do.
verses.pt: este se acha hospedado com um certo Simão, curtidor, cuja casa fica à beira-mar. [Ele te dirá o que deves fazer.]
verses.en_web: He lodges with a tanner named Simon, whose house is by the seaside.
verses.en_bbe: Who is living with Simon, a leather-worker, whose house is by the sea.

verses.en: And when the angel which spake unto Cornelius was departed, he called two of his household servants, and a devout soldier of them that waited on him continually;
verses.pt: Logo que se retirou o anjo que lhe falava, Cornélio chamou dois dos seus domésticos e um piedoso soldado dos que estavam a seu serviço;
verses.en_web: When the angel who spoke to him had departed, Cornelius called two of his household servants and a devout soldier of those who waited on him continually.
verses.en_bbe: And when the angel who said these words to him had gone away, he sent for two of his house-servants, and a God-fearing man of the army, one of those who were waiting on him at all times;

verses.en: And when he had declared all these things unto them, he sent them to Joppa.
verses.pt: e, havendo contado tudo, os enviou a Jope.
verses.en_web: Having explained everything to them, he sent them to Joppa.
verses.en_bbe: And having given them an account of everything, he sent them to Joppa.

verses.en: On the morrow, as they went on their journey, and drew nigh unto the city, Peter went up upon the housetop to pray about the sixth hour:
verses.pt: No dia seguinte, indo eles seu caminho e estando já perto da cidade, subiu Pedro ao eirado para orar, cerca de hora sexta.
verses.en_web: Now on the next day as they were on their journey, and got close to the city, Peter went up on the housetop to pray at about noon.
verses.en_bbe: Now the day after, when they were on their journey and were near the town, Peter went up to the top of the house for prayer, about the sixth hour:

verses.en: And he became very hungry, and would have eaten: but while they made ready, he fell into a trance,
verses.pt: E tendo fome, quis comer; mas enquanto lhe preparavam a comida, sobreveio-lhe um êxtase,
verses.en_web: He became hungry and desired to eat, but while they were preparing, he fell into a trance.
verses.en_bbe: And he was in need of food: but while they were getting it ready, a deep sleep came on him;

verses.en: And saw heaven opened, and a certain vessel descending unto him, as it had been a great sheet knit at the four corners, and let down to the earth:
verses.pt: e via o céu aberto e um objeto descendo, como se fosse um grande lençol, sendo baixado pelas quatro pontas sobre a terra,
verses.en_web: He saw heaven opened and a certain container descending to him, like a great sheet let down by four corners on the earth,
verses.en_bbe: And he saw the heavens opening, and a vessel coming down, like a great cloth let down on the earth,

verses.en: Wherein were all manner of fourfooted beasts of the earth, and wild beasts, and creeping things, and fowls of the air.
verses.pt: no qual havia de todos os quadrúpedes e répteis da terra e aves do céu.
verses.en_web: in which were all kinds of four-footed animals of the earth, wild animals, reptiles, and birds of the sky.
verses.en_bbe: In which were all sorts of beasts and birds.

verses.en: And there came a voice to him, Rise, Peter; kill, and eat.
verses.pt: E uma voz lhe disse: Levanta-te, Pedro, mata e come.
verses.en_web: A voice came to him, “Rise, Peter, kill and eat!”
verses.en_bbe: And a voice came to him, saying, Come, Peter; take them for food.

verses.en: But Peter said, Not so, Lord; for I have never eaten any thing that is common or unclean.
verses.pt: Mas Pedro respondeu: De modo nenhum, Senhor, porque nunca comi coisa alguma comum e imunda.
verses.en_web: But Peter said, “Not so, Lord; for I have never eaten anything that is common or unclean.”
verses.en_bbe: But Peter said, No, Lord; for I have never taken food which is common or unclean.

verses.en: And the voice spake unto him again the second time, What God hath cleansed, that call not thou common.
verses.pt: Pela segunda vez lhe falou a voz: Não chames tu comum ao que Deus purificou.
verses.en_web: A voice came to him again the second time, “What God has cleansed, you must not call unclean.”
verses.en_bbe: And the voice came to him a second time, What God has made clean, do not you make common.

verses.en: This was done thrice: and the vessel was received up again into heaven.
verses.pt: Sucedeu isto por três vezes; e logo foi o objeto recolhido ao céu.
verses.en_web: This was done three times, and immediately the vessel was received up into heaven.
verses.en_bbe: And this was done three times: and then the vessel was taken back into heaven.

verses.en: Now while Peter doubted in himself what this vision which he had seen should mean, behold, the men which were sent from Cornelius had made enquiry for Simon’s house, and stood before the gate,
verses.pt: Enquanto Pedro refletia, perplexo, sobre o que seria a visão que tivera, eis que os homens enviados por Cornélio, tendo perguntado pela casa de Simão, pararam à porta.
verses.en_web: Now while Peter was very perplexed in himself what the vision which he had seen might mean, behold, the men who were sent by Cornelius, having made inquiry for Simon’s house, stood before the gate,
verses.en_bbe: Now while Peter was in doubt as to the purpose of this vision, the men who were sent by Cornelius, having made search for Simon's house, came to the door,

verses.en: And called, and asked whether Simon, which was surnamed Peter, were lodged there.
verses.pt: E, chamando, indagavam se ali estava hospedado Simão, que tinha por sobrenome Pedro.
verses.en_web: and called and asked whether Simon, who was also called Peter, was lodging there.
verses.en_bbe: To see if Simon, named Peter, was living there.

verses.en: While Peter thought on the vision, the Spirit said unto him, Behold, three men seek thee.
verses.pt: Estando Pedro ainda a meditar sobre a visão, o Espírito lhe disse: Eis que dois homens te procuram.
verses.en_web: While Peter was pondering the vision, the Spirit said to him, “Behold, three men seek you.
verses.en_bbe: And, while Peter was turning the vision over in his mind, the Spirit said to him, See, three men are looking for you.

verses.en: Arise therefore, and get thee down, and go with them, doubting nothing: for I have sent them.
verses.pt: Levanta-te, pois, desce e vai com eles, nada duvidando; porque eu tos enviei.
verses.en_web: But arise, get down, and go with them, doubting nothing; for I have sent them.”
verses.en_bbe: Go down, then, and go with them, doubting nothing, for I have sent them.

verses.en: Then Peter went down to the men which were sent unto him from Cornelius; and said, Behold, I am he whom ye seek: what is the cause wherefore ye are come?
verses.pt: E descendo Pedro ao encontro desses homens, disse: Sou eu a quem procurais; qual é a causa por que viestes?
verses.en_web: Peter went down to the men, and said, “Behold, I am he whom you seek. Why have you come?”
verses.en_bbe: And Peter went down to the men, and said, I am the man you are looking for: why have you come?

verses.en: And they said, Cornelius the centurion, a just man, and one that feareth God, and of good report among all the nation of the Jews, was warned from God by an holy angel to send for thee into his house, and to hear words of thee.
verses.pt: Eles responderam: O centurião Cornélio, homem justo e temente a Deus e que tem bom testemunho de toda a nação judaica, foi avisado por um santo anjo para te chamar à sua casa e ouvir as tuas palavras.
verses.en_web: They said, “Cornelius, a centurion, a righteous man and one who fears God, and well spoken of by all the nation of the Jews, was directed by a holy angel to invite you to his house, and to listen to what you say.”
verses.en_bbe: And they said, Cornelius, a captain, an upright and God-fearing man, respected by all the nation of the Jews, had word from God by an angel to send for you to his house, and to give hearing to your words.

verses.en: Then called he them in, and lodged them. And on the morrow Peter went away with them, and certain brethren from Joppa accompanied him.
verses.pt: Pedro, pois, convidando-os a entrar, os hospedou. No dia seguinte levantou-se e partiu com eles, e alguns irmãos, dentre os de Jope, o acompanharam.
verses.en_web: So he called them in and provided a place to stay. On the next day Peter arose and went out with them, and some of the brothers from Joppa accompanied him.
verses.en_bbe: So he took them in for the night. And the day after, he went with them, taking some of the brothers from Joppa with him.

verses.en: And the morrow after they entered into Caesarea. And Cornelius waited for them, and had called together his kinsmen and near friends.
verses.pt: No outro dia entrou em Cesaréia. E Cornélio os esperava, tendo reunido os seus parentes e amigos mais íntimos.
verses.en_web: On the next day they entered into Caesarea. Cornelius was waiting for them, having called together his relatives and his near friends.
verses.en_bbe: And the day after that, they came to Caesarea. And Cornelius was waiting for them, having got together his relations and his near friends.

verses.en: And as Peter was coming in, Cornelius met him, and fell down at his feet, and worshipped him.
verses.pt: Quando Pedro ia entrar, veio-lhe Cornélio ao encontro e, prostrando-se a seus pés, o adorou.
verses.en_web: When Peter entered, Cornelius met him, fell down at his feet, and worshiped him.
verses.en_bbe: And when Peter came in, Cornelius came to him and, falling down at his feet, gave him worship.

verses.en: But Peter took him up, saying, Stand up; I myself also am a man.
verses.pt: Mas Pedro o ergueu, dizendo: Levanta-te, que eu também sou homem.
verses.en_web: But Peter raised him up, saying, “Stand up! I myself am also a man.”
verses.en_bbe: But Peter, lifting him up, said, Get up, for I am a man as you are.

verses.en: And as he talked with him, he went in, and found many that were come together.
verses.pt: E conversando com ele, entrou e achou muitos reunidos,
verses.en_web: As he talked with him, he went in and found many gathered together.
verses.en_bbe: And saying these words, he went in, and saw that a great number of people had come together;

verses.en: And he said unto them, Ye know how that it is an unlawful thing for a man that is a Jew to keep company, or come unto one of another nation; but God hath shewed me that I should not call any man common or unclean.
verses.pt: e disse-lhes: Vós bem sabeis que não é lícito a um judeu ajuntar-se ou chegar-se a estrangeiros; mas Deus mostrou-me que a nenhum homem devo chamar comum ou imundo;
verses.en_web: He said to them, “You yourselves know how it is an unlawful thing for a man who is a Jew to join himself or come to one of another nation, but God has shown me that I shouldn’t call any man unholy or unclean.
verses.en_bbe: And he said to them, You yourselves have knowledge that it is against the law for a man who is a Jew to be in the company of one who is of another nation; but God has made it clear to me that no man may be named common or unclean:

verses.en: Therefore came I unto you without gainsaying, as soon as I was sent for: I ask therefore for what intent ye have sent for me?
verses.pt: pelo que, sendo chamado, vim sem objeção. Pergunto pois: Por que razão mandastes chamar-me?
verses.en_web: Therefore also I came without complaint when I was sent for. I ask therefore, why did you send for me?”
verses.en_bbe: And so I came without question, when I was sent for. What then is your purpose in sending for me?

verses.en: And Cornelius said, Four days ago I was fasting until this hour; and at the ninth hour I prayed in my house, and, behold, a man stood before me in bright clothing,
verses.pt: Então disse Cornélio: Faz agora quatro dias que eu estava orando em minha casa à hora nona, e eis que diante de mim se apresentou um homem com vestiduras resplandescentes,
verses.en_web: Cornelius said, “Four days ago, I was fasting until this hour, and at the ninth hour, I prayed in my house, and behold, a man stood before me in bright clothing,
verses.en_bbe: And Cornelius said, Four days from now I was in my house in prayer at the ninth hour; and I saw before me a man in shining clothing,

verses.en: And said, Cornelius, thy prayer is heard, and thine alms are had in remembrance in the sight of God.
verses.pt: e disse: Cornélio, a tua oração foi ouvida, e as tuas esmolas estão em memória diante de Deus.
verses.en_web: and said, ‘Cornelius, your prayer is heard, and your gifts to the needy are remembered in the sight of God.
verses.en_bbe: Who said, Cornelius, your prayer has come to the ears of God, and your offerings are kept in his memory.

verses.en: Send therefore to Joppa, and call hither Simon, whose surname is Peter; he is lodged in the house of one Simon a tanner by the sea side: who, when he cometh, shall speak unto thee.
verses.pt: Envia, pois, a Jope e manda chamar a Simão, que tem por sobrenome Pedro; ele está hospedado em casa de Simão, curtidor, à beira-mar.
verses.en_web: Send therefore to Joppa, and summon Simon, who is also called Peter. He lodges in the house of a tanner named Simon, by the seaside. When he comes, he will speak to you.’
verses.en_bbe: Send, then, to Joppa, and get Simon, named Peter, to come to you; he is living in the house of Simon, a leather-worker, by the sea.

verses.en: Immediately therefore I sent to thee; and thou hast well done that thou art come. Now therefore are we all here present before God, to hear all things that are commanded thee of God.
verses.pt: Portanto mandei logo chamar-te, e bem fizeste em vir. Agora pois estamos todos aqui presentes diante de Deus, para ouvir tudo quanto te foi ordenado pelo Senhor.
verses.en_web: Therefore I sent to you at once, and it was good of you to come. Now therefore we are all here present in the sight of God to hear all things that have been commanded you by God.”
verses.en_bbe: So, straight away, I sent for you; and you have done well to come. And now, we are all present before God, ready to give attention to all the things which the Lord has given you to say.

verses.en: Then Peter opened his mouth, and said, Of a truth I perceive that God is no respecter of persons:
verses.pt: Então Pedro, tomando a palavra, disse: Na verdade reconheço que Deus não faz acepção de pessoas;
verses.en_web: Peter opened his mouth and said, “Truly I perceive that God doesn’t show favoritism;
verses.en_bbe: Then Peter said, Truly, I see clearly that God is no respecter of persons:

verses.en: But in every nation he that feareth him, and worketh righteousness, is accepted with him.
verses.pt: mas que lhe é aceitável aquele que, em qualquer nação, o teme e pratica o que é justo.
verses.en_web: but in every nation he who fears him and works righteousness is acceptable to him.
verses.en_bbe: But in every nation, the man who has fear of him and does righteousness is pleasing to him.

verses.en: The word which God sent unto the children of Israel, preaching peace by Jesus Christ: (he is Lord of all:)
verses.pt: A palavra que ele enviou aos filhos de Israel, anunciando a paz por Jesus Cristo (este é o Senhor de todos) -
verses.en_web: The word which he sent to the children of Israel, preaching good news of peace by Jesus Christ—he is Lord of all—
verses.en_bbe: The word which he sent to the children of Israel, giving the good news of peace through Jesus Christ (who is Lord of all)--

verses.en: That word, I say, ye know, which was published throughout all Judaea, and began from Galilee, after the baptism which John preached;
verses.pt: esta palavra, vós bem sabeis, foi proclamada por toda a Judéia, começando pela Galiléia, depois do batismo que João pregou,
verses.en_web: you yourselves know what happened, which was proclaimed throughout all Judea, beginning from Galilee, after the baptism which John preached;
verses.en_bbe: That word you yourselves have knowledge of, which was made public through all Judaea, starting from Galilee, after the baptism of which John was the preacher,

verses.en: How God anointed Jesus of Nazareth with the Holy Ghost and with power: who went about doing good, and healing all that were oppressed of the devil; for God was with him.
verses.pt: concernente a Jesus de Nazaré, como Deus o ungiu com o Espírito Santo e com poder; o qual andou por toda parte, fazendo o bem e curando a todos os oprimidos do Diabo, porque Deus era com ele.
verses.en_web: even Jesus of Nazareth, how God anointed him with the Holy Spirit and with power, who went about doing good and healing all who were oppressed by the devil, for God was with him.
verses.en_bbe: About Jesus of Nazareth, how God gave the Holy Spirit to him, with power: and how he went about doing good and making well all who were troubled by evil spirits, for God was with him.

verses.en: And we are witnesses of all things which he did both in the land of the Jews, and in Jerusalem; whom they slew and hanged on a tree:
verses.pt: Nós somos testemunhas de tudo quanto fez, tanto na terra dos judeus como em Jerusalém; ao qual mataram, pendurando-o num madeiro.
verses.en_web: We are witnesses of everything he did both in the country of the Jews, and in Jerusalem; whom they also killed, hanging him on a tree.
verses.en_bbe: And we are witnesses of all the things which he did in the country of the Jews and in Jerusalem; whom they put to death, hanging him on a tree.

verses.en: Him God raised up the third day, and shewed him openly;
verses.pt: A este ressuscitou Deus ao terceiro dia e lhe concedeu que se manifestasse,
verses.en_web: God raised him up the third day, and gave him to be revealed,
verses.en_bbe: On the third day God gave him back to life, and let him be seen,

verses.en: Not to all the people, but unto witnesses chosen before of God, even to us, who did eat and drink with him after he rose from the dead.
verses.pt: não a todo povo, mas às testemunhas predeterminadas por Deus, a nós, que comemos e bebemos juntamente com ele depois que ressurgiu dentre os mortos;
verses.en_web: not to all the people, but to witnesses who were chosen before by God, to us, who ate and drank with him after he rose from the dead.
verses.en_bbe: Not by all the people, but by witnesses marked out before by God, even by us, who took food and drink with him after he came back from the dead.

verses.en: And he commanded us to preach unto the people, and to testify that it is he which was ordained of God to be the Judge of quick and dead.
verses.pt: este nos mandou pregar ao povo, e testificar que ele é o que por Deus foi constituído juiz dos vivos e dos mortos.
verses.en_web: He commanded us to preach to the people and to testify that this is he who is appointed by God as the Judge of the living and the dead.
verses.en_bbe: And he gave us orders to give news of this to the people, and to give public witness that this is he whom God has made judge of the living and the dead.

verses.en: To him give all the prophets witness, that through his name whosoever believeth in him shall receive remission of sins.
verses.pt: A ele todos os profetas dão testemunho de que todo o que nele crê receberá a remissão dos pecados pelo seu nome.
verses.en_web: All the prophets testify about him, that through his name everyone who believes in him will receive remission of sins.”
verses.en_bbe: To him all the prophets give witness, that through his name everyone who has faith in him will have forgiveness of sins.

verses.en: While Peter yet spake these words, the Holy Ghost fell on all them which heard the word.
verses.pt: Enquanto Pedro ainda dizia estas coisas, desceu o Espírito Santo sobre todos os que ouviam a palavra.
verses.en_web: While Peter was still speaking these words, the Holy Spirit fell on all those who heard the word.
verses.en_bbe: While Peter was saying these words, the Holy Spirit came on all those who were hearing the word.

verses.en: And they of the circumcision which believed were astonished, as many as came with Peter, because that on the Gentiles also was poured out the gift of the Holy Ghost.
verses.pt: Os crentes que eram de circuncisão, todos quantos tinham vindo com Pedro, maravilharam-se de que também sobre os gentios se derramasse o dom do Espírito Santo;
verses.en_web: They of the circumcision who believed were amazed, as many as came with Peter, because the gift of the Holy Spirit was also poured out on the Gentiles.
verses.en_bbe: And the Jews of the faith, who had come with Peter, were full of wonder, because the Holy Spirit was given to the Gentiles,

verses.en: For they heard them speak with tongues, and magnify God. Then answered Peter,
verses.pt: porque os ouviam falar línguas e magnificar a Deus.
verses.en_web: For they heard them speaking in other languages and magnifying God. Then Peter answered,
verses.en_bbe: And they were talking in tongues, and giving glory to God. Then Peter said,

verses.en: Can any man forbid water, that these should not be baptized, which have received the Holy Ghost as well as we?
verses.pt: Respondeu então Pedro: Pode alguém porventura recusar a água para que não sejam batizados estes que também, como nós, receberam o Espírito Santo?
verses.en_web: “Can anyone forbid these people from being baptized with water? They have received the Holy Spirit just like us.”
verses.en_bbe: Will any man say that these may not have baptism who have been given the Holy Spirit as we have?

verses.en: And he commanded them to be baptized in the name of the Lord. Then prayed they him to tarry certain days.
verses.pt: Mandou, pois, que fossem batizados em nome de Jesus Cristo. Então lhe rogaram que ficasse com eles por alguns dias.
verses.en_web: He commanded them to be baptized in the name of Jesus Christ. Then they asked him to stay some days.
verses.en_bbe: And he gave orders for them to have baptism in the name of Jesus Christ. Then they kept him with them for some days.
